messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Smart routing anomalies detected — repeated fallback loop between model variants and regions. Auto-pager triggered to oncall. Short summary: increased 5xx rate and tool-call failures starting ~1865301210.

maya (oncall): ack — investigating now. hopping on the router logs. tagging @alex in case I need handoff.

alex (oncall): i'm online and available to take if you need a break.

incident-bot: Alert details: repeated 502/500 spikes starting 1865301210, observed symptom: 'tool_call not supported by selected model_variant' -> router triggered multiple fallbacks across regions leading to routing loop. Faulty policy: smart-route-v2.

eng-runtime: pasting the router excerpt that shows the loop behavior:
```text
[1865301210] route_decision: req_id=ptk-9a2, policy=smart-route-v2
selected_variant=gptx-quant8
capabilities=[generate,embeddings]
required_capabilities=[generate,tool_call]
result=capability_mismatch -> trigger_fallback(region=eu-west-1)
[1865301211] fallback: selected_variant=gptx-fp16-toolcall -> connection_timeout -> fallback_again
loop_detected: 3 iterations
```

eng-runtime: preliminary root cause: compatibility/availability matrix used by smart-router is missing/incorrect for quant variants. gptx-quant8 does NOT support tool_call, but the matrix either omitted that capability or it was marked true incorrectly. router picks quant variant for cost/latency and then fallback churns.

sre-lead: impact? which customers and severity?

cust-ops: affected customers: cust-123 (finance-prod, us-west-2), cust-42 (analytics, eu-west-1). Support cases opened: #24 (cust-123), #27 (cust-42). Metrics: latency +2.1x, error rate +12% for affected routes. Several requests returned tool-call errors (422/500) or timed out.

infra-dev: applied a temporary mitigation — disabled smart-route-v2 selection for ambiguous variants. Command used:
```bash
redwoodctl policies update smart-route-v2 --set "enabled=false" --scope=global
```
Deployed at 1865301250 :heavy_check_mark:

maya (oncall): confirmed customer error rate decreasing for cust-123 after patch. Also pinned customer routes to a known-good model for immediate mitigation:
```yaml
routes:
  - customer: cust-123
    model: gptx-fp16-toolcall
    pin: true
```

deploy-bot: rollout succeeded: 5/5 routers updated @1865301270

sre-lead: good containment. handing ongoing remediation to alex for full fix and post-incident follow-through. maya will author the postmortem.

alex (oncall): taking lead. next steps and owners:
1) Fix capability matrix source so quant variants explicitly list tool_call: true/false (owner: eng-runtime) — target: EOD.
2) Add router-side validation: reject selecting variant that lacks required capabilities; failover should pick only compatible variants (owner: eng-runtime) — PR in progress.
3) Add unit/integration test for smart-route that simulates tool_call requirement and confirms no incompatible variant is chosen (owner: eng-ml).
4) Customer communications draft and SLA check (owner: cust-ops).
I'll open GH issues and link them here.

product-lead: please include impacted customers in comms and offer incident credit per SLA if thresholds met. Keep messaging technical but clear.

cust-ops: initial messages sent to cust-123 and cust-42 with ETA 2h for patch; support is triaging customer cases.

eng-runtime: created hotfix PR #4823 that adds capability validation to the ingest pipeline for the compatibility matrix. Staging runs green. Will request review now.

maya (oncall): handing off active monitoring to alex at 1865301305. Notes added to #oncall-runbook and the thread. :wave:

alex (oncall): will monitor metrics for 1h; plan to close pager when error rates and latency return to baseline. assigning postmortem ownership to maya.

sre-lead: thanks all — keep updates in this thread only. We'll schedule a blameless postmortem; primary items: matrix correctness, router policy hardening, and improved canary for capability-sensitive rollouts.

-- actions summary --
- eng-runtime: fix capability matrix + PR (#4823) — due EOD — assigned
- eng-runtime: router validation to block incompatible variant selection — PR in progress
- eng-ml: add routing simulation tests for tool_call flag — owner assigned
- cust-ops: customer comms + SLA check — posted drafts
- maya: postmortem writeup (owner) — draft due tomorrow

incident-bot: Pager cleared once metrics stable or manual close by oncall.

-- end of thread --
